normalisation_rule: DOI comparison is case-insensitive and strips https://doi.org/; URL comparison strips query-only language noise
notes: Highest-confidence duplicate key for DOI-bearing sources.

normalisation_rule: Trim whitespace and punctuation noise; compare formal report regulation publication or document identifiers case-insensitively
notes: Formal revised editions may be distinct only when revision is material and relationship is recorded.

normalisation_rule: Canonicalise stable URL by lowercasing scheme and host and ignoring download language query parameters
notes: Alternative download URLs for the same document are not new sources.

normalisation_rule: Compare title and organisation case-insensitively with repeated spaces collapsed
notes: Used when DOI identifier or stable URL is absent.

normalisation_rule: Trim whitespace normalise empty numeric fields and compare canonical source IDs exactly
notes: Duplicate deepsearch route is not a reason to add another evidence row.

normalisation_rule: Keep separate evidence row when a different canonical source supports the same value or range
notes: Corroborating evidence from different sources is not automatically duplicate.

normalisation_rule: Do not average conflicting values; retain source-supported values separately with review status
notes: Conflicts must remain visible for later selection.
